entities.name: Rejected NSSAI
entities.description: Information element included by the network to inform the UE of one or more S-NSSAIs that were included in the requested NSSAI but were rejected.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the UE containing the requested NSSAI.

entities.name: Requested NSSAI
entities.description: Information element included in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message containing the S-NSSAIs requested by the UE.

entities.name: S-NSSAI
entities.description: Single Network Slice Selection Assistance Information, a component of the NSSAI.

relations.description: REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains the Requested NSSAI IE.
Requested NSSAI IE contains one or more S-NSSAIs.
Rejected NSSAI IE contains one or more S-NSSAIs that were rejected by the network.
